_why: Operator 2026-10-31 (verbatim): "validate all stuck agents and processes fix montior and make auto healings with claude code". After the 2026-10-30 disk-full the CIO wake pipeline self-deadlocked for 31 h, tradeai-cio-reactive sat 'activating' forever, zero-byte state files failed units, eight n8n breakers stayed open and the overnight LLM queue completed nothing; nothing said so. scripts/stuck_work_monitor.py reads; heals and the fixer hand-off run only when switched on below (AGENTS.md §25.10.2). Ending a process is never done here (§28.1).

locks._why: A waiter older than lock_wait_min that is in a kernel lock wait now. A pid holding and waiting the same path is a self-deadlock (code defect).

processes._why: D state past d_state_min, or a watched command past its MEASURED cap (cap_source cites the measurement; none are measured yet, so watched is empty — §28.1).

units._why: Hung oneshot (activating), failed past grace with an expected-refusal list, oneshot lint (TimeoutStartUSec=infinity, sweep: 38 units), and overrun/CPU-bound runs for units with a known timer period (cio-delivery: 3 min 59 s CPU of 4 min 33 s every 5 min, 0 delivered).

queues.name: deep_overnight_llm_queue
queues.pending_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM deep_overnight_llm_queue WHERE status = 'pending'
queues.last_done_sql: SELECT max(completed_at) FROM deep_overnight_llm_queue WHERE status = 'done'

queues.name: agent_event_queue
queues.pending_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM agent_event_queue WHERE status = 'pending'
queues.last_done_sql: SELECT max(processed_at) FROM agent_event_queue WHERE status = 'done'
queues.stuck_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM agent_event_queue WHERE status = 'processing' AND created_at < now() - interval '6 hours'

queues.name: watchlist_agent_jobs
queues.pending_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM watchlist_agent_jobs WHERE status = 'queued'
queues.last_done_sql: SELECT max(completed_at) FROM watchlist_agent_jobs WHERE status = 'completed'

heartbeats.sql: SELECT agent_id, last_seen, status, error_count FROM agent_heartbeat

lanes._why: Watched lanes page; all other ACTIVE lanes past cadence x multiplier + margin are counted in one P3 summary. Market-day-only lanes (e.g. premarket-delivery-deadman) are not watched here because they are silent every weekend by design; they carry their own dead-man.
lanes._ledger_why: Coordinator 2026-10-31 (sweep-fix PR #2375): 13 of 16 'missing receipt' ACTIVE lanes are shadow/canary lanes that by design never write the live *_last.json; making dry runs write live receipts would falsify output. Their liveness is the coordination ledger's newest RUN_DONE.

heals._heals_why: heals_enabled stays false. reconcile_lock is §28.14's stale-lock reconcile. repair_tail and restore_backup are NOT in §28.14's four deterministic fixes: they may be enabled only after the operator ratifies a §28.14 amendment naming them (review 2026-10-31). Every heal re-checks at act time under the store's flock: file quiet for quiet_min, mtime unchanged since the finding, no holder; a restore needs a backup younger than backup_max_age_h whose JSON still parses; the original is archived first; a tail repair truncates in place, never replaces the file.

stale_release._why: Coordinator 2026-10-31, found live: tradeai-ops-applier ran release f7c1e96cb from 10-22 until the operator restarted it at 10:43 ET 10-31, refusing every newer Ops Controls kind as KIND_UNKNOWN. A unit resolves CURRENT once at start. PAGE ONLY (review 2026-10-31): a restart ends a run and AGENTS.md §28.1 names the only four automations that may. The real fix is the deploy script's CURRENT-bound unit list (scripts/cio_phase2_exact_main_deploy.sh restart_root_frozen_units), which misses the applier, both OAuth proxies and heartbeat-receiver.

_never_act_why: Additions only: scripts/lib/stuck_work.py NEVER_ACT is the code floor (portfolio-server, broker, order, stop, position, account, paper, scalp, sender, telegram, secret, guard, deploy, release, retention, agent-loop, dof, ...); config can add patterns here, never remove one.
_market_windows_why: premarket-delivery-deadman is not a window lane: it writes no signal file on a quiet morning (it is itself the dead-man), so checking it would page a missed window every trading day (review 2026-10-31).
